metadata.description: Ways of working with coding agents (Claude Code, Hermes, Codex), one plugin per idea: skills, an output style and mods used daily and refined in real work.

plugins.name: show
plugins.description: When an agent's result or intent is hard to follow as text, find where the reader gets stuck and build one HTML page that unblocks it: drawn diagrams, step playback, live what-if figures, real screenshots, diffs. Reports get verdicts, collected decisions, mobile and A4 print. Docs are in Korean.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Write proposals, quotes, reports, slide decks, manuals, specs and handbooks as one HTML file and render a PDF. Content kind, layout and brand are picked separately. Docs are in Korean.

plugins.name: professionalify
plugins.description: Measure and raise the professionalism of documents, slides, charts, diagrams and UI copy along 16 axes, and absorb each piece of feedback back into the axis docs. Docs are in Korean.

plugins.name: meeting-notes
plugins.description: Turn a meeting transcript into one notes folder: decisions and actions first, agenda order, PDF, and a numbered question list instead of guesses. Docs are in Korean.

plugins.name: feedback-reply
plugins.description: Draft a first-person reply to team feedback that answers every point with one of four dispositions and concrete concessions. Korean only.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Ask one question to several model CLIs, have them rank the anonymized answers, and synthesize one answer as chair. Docs are in Korean.

plugins.name: skill-authoring
plugins.description: A method and scripts for building and refining agent skills: structure, routing, instruction shape, link and sentence-snapshot checks. Docs are in Korean.

plugins.name: plain-korean
plugins.description: Output style for agents working in Korean: answer first, plain sentences, actions and numbers over metaphors, keyboard-typable characters, rules per place the text lands.

plugins.name: quiet
plugins.description: Hide tool call rows so the transcript shows only the conversation. Toggle with /quiet.
